question: If we switch paper/live taker from snapshot-fill to FOK, how do the four Rev 8 paper fills change?
current_paper: Fill both legs immediately at the hunt snapshot VWAP if net>0 after fees. No delay. Size is the scanned depth.

fok.why: Crypto up/down CLOB markets set itode=true: live taker orders are held 250ms then revalidated.
fok.rule: After the delay, HTTP both books. Full original size must still be available at price <= snapshot limits on BOTH legs, and taker_net must stay >0. Otherwise kill, no paper PnL.
fok.live_caveat: CLOB cannot atomically FOK two tokens. Paper pair-FOK fills neither if either leg would kill. Sequential live FOK can still leave one filled leg if the second dies; FORCE_PAPER stays on.
